title: Concept: Upload storage path returned
description: A storage path for an uploaded document in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The path names the bucket layout and the document type, and a predictable path lets an attacker fetch or overwrite another customer's upload.
applicability: Deployments that render a storage path for an uploaded document into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The path names the bucket layout and the document type, and a predictable path lets an attacker fetch or overwrite another customer's upload.
